summary: Kazia Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K disclosing the appointment of JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as sole depositary for its American Depositary Receipt program, replacing The Bank of New York Mellon, effective September 18, 2026. The Second Amended and Restated Deposit Agreement governs issuance of American Depositary Shares, each representing 500 ordinary shares, which continue trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market under KZIA. JPMorgan filed a Form F-6 registration statement. No price, stake, premium or close date applies; holders need take no action. This is a routine depositary change, not a special situation; watch for any operational disruption during transfer.
